title: RESOURCE: Introducing the Cyber Incident Registry
content_md: Over on DysruptionHub, Joseph Topping has introduced a new resource for exploring cyber disruptions, following incidents over time, and uncovering the connections between them: The registry is a research resource focused specifically on cyber disruptions. Each incident profile brings together what is publicly known about what happened, who was affected, the operational impact, the available… Source Article Link: https://databreaches.net/2026/08/12/resource-introducing-the-cyber-incident-registry/
